# Facebook Pages

`facebook` · openapi · version `v26.0` · **drafts** · readiness `discovered`

| GET | `/v26.0/me` | getMe | `fields` | object | yes | Get the signed-in Facebook user's ID and name |
| GET | `/v26.0/me/accounts` | listPages | `fields`, `limit`, `after` | object | yes | List the Facebook Pages the user granted this app |
